title: Ramp agent ticker
description: A thin frosted bar of live counters: an uppercase label with a small icon, then a row of 'LABEL: number' pairs in grey mono chips that slides left forever while the numbers keep ticking up. It sticks to the bottom of the window until the page scrolls it into its own place.
notes: place it straight after a hero taller than the window: it rides the window's bottom edge, then settles under the hero
marquee is CSS; JavaScript only ticks the numbers; with reduced motion both stop
